If the view is edited to `p.sku AS partner_ref`, the export sends codes Oakline Supply does not know, and it cannot match the 6,140 migrated products. reconstruction.fix: Keep the column until Oakline Supply re-keys to the new `sku`. After that: change `v_partner_feed` to `p.sku AS partner_ref`, remove the line from `db/schema.sql`, add the DROP COLUMN migration after the view change, delete the importer or remove the column from its INSERT, and add a note to `docs/history/2024-brightstock-migration.md`.
reconstruction.cost: Keeping the column costs one nullable text field. The later drop needs the four edits above plus Oakline Supply confirming the re-key. Dropping early, if the re-key has not happened, costs a broken partner feed and unrecoverable data.
